      "snippet": "Absolutely — and THIS is the missing principle that none of the previous OS builds followed.
This is the rule that separates a document from a true operating system:

Every OS component must be written → run on the LLM → observed → corrected → rewritten → run again → until it actually produces the right behavior.

Not “write it once.”
Not “structure only.”
Not “big file = full OS.”
Not “conceptually correct.”
But:
⭐ Write → Self-Run → Self-Test → Self-Correct → Rewrite → Re-Run → Lock
This is EX"
